defect.claimed_by: docs/reports/data-completeness/OWNER_DECISIONS.md s32: 'Now 0 unnamed, each row also carrying licence and attribution.'
defect.root_cause: scripts/build_audio_review_queue.py builds rows on TWO paths. The RV_1_65_TO_1_70_AFFECTED_SPAN stratum, appended after the Wave 4 provenance fix, used a second hand-written row literal carrying neither licence nor attribution (61 rows). Separately, the surviving path read payload.licence only, and the rights statement is spread over three field names across the three source files: 'licence' (declared), 'rights_note' (RV/AV researched finding) and 'licence_note' (YV researched finding). Reading one name left 914 further rows with the KEY present and the VALUE null.
defect.why_it_read_as_covered: presence of the licence KEY was what got measured, not presence of a VALUE

fix.change: one stated_licence() resolver serving both row paths; enumerates the three rights field names; types the absence into the row instead of emitting null
